verdict.rationale: Lium's docs say an agent can do everything with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods (lium-docs-22). This is backed by API signup (lium-docs-25), rent-by-spec (lium-docs-6), scoped and budgeted API keys (lium-docs-7, lium-docs-12), a published OpenAPI spec at lium.io/api/openapi.json (lium-docs-20), and stable error codes (lium-docs-21). The probe's 404s were against docs.lium.io paths, not the documented lium.io/api path, so they do not contradict the spec's existence. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of full UI parity, and explicit API coverage for volumes, clusters, backups/restore and Jupyter toggles.
